تسلون (form I)
# تَسُلُّونَ (tasullūna) /ta.sul.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of سَلَّ (salla)
# تُسَلُّونَ (tusallūna) /tu.sal.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of سَلَّ (salla) and سُلَّ (sulla)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
